recipe.criteria: Supine, arms beside torso palms down. Straight legs lower together from vertical to 15 degrees above horizontal over 3.5 seconds, pause 1 second and return over 3.5 seconds. Back remains supported without pelvic curl; low head cushion.
limitations: Procedural demonstration; support samples are not full collision or biomechanical certification.
Timing is illustrative; lower only while keeping the back supported.
